Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through the demo and requirements. - POC integration & throughput test — target: 2026-04-21 — owner: ACME / Redwood (Connor)

- Contract finalization & procurement sign-off — target: 2026-05-05 — owner: ACME Legal / Procurement

Open dependencies we called out: network peering confirmation, SOC2 artifact transfer, and a short list of sample queries to validate latency. I included checkboxes and a version history in the spreadsheet so we can iterate.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Please review the attached MAP and mark any ownership changes inline.
2) Confirm whether procurement requires a redline timeline for the contract.
3) If the dates look off, flag the milestone(s) you want to shift and suggest alternatives.

I'll follow up next Thursday with a short weekly checkpoint email to keep everything moving. If you prefer daily Slack syncs for the first week, happy to set that up.
